notes: Every number is an explicit synthetic experiment input; none is observed chain state.
Arbitrum PricePerUnit and Scroll oracle scalars are retained even though their pinned compression executables are unavailable, so those fee totals remain NOT_EVALUATED.
The OP scalar choices are synthetic and must not be described as OP Mainnet state.

measurement_scope: local bytes and deterministic signatures only; source admission and all fees are projections

signer.key: universally public Anvil account 0, never funded

caveats: Historical Ethereum gas is not an L2 receipt or L2 gas measurement.
Two separate transaction size tests; their total is never compared to one transaction cap.
Two calls incur two intrinsic floors and two fee rounding/compression operations.
Scroll same-block aggregate payload limit is separate; sequential blocks are allowed in this diagnostic.
Raw signed bytes are not persisted and no RPC/broadcast facility exists.
Missing pinned Nitro/Scroll compression leaves fee totals null; no substitute compressor.
Size admission alone does not establish affordable/private/sound withdrawals.

source_rules.admission_rule: serialized type-2 transaction length <= 128 KiB and gasLimit <= 2^24; deposits exempt
source_rules.da_footprint_formula: max(100, floor((-42585600 + 836500*fastlzSize)/1e6)) * daFootprintGasScalar; zero configured scalar maps to 400
source_rules.estimator: FastLZ of complete signed serialized transaction
source_rules.finality: Sequencer inclusion is provisional; safe/finalized follows Ethereum L1
source_rules.withdrawal: Approximately seven days through the respected CANNON_KONA type-8 fault-proof game
source_rules.security_assumption: At least one honest challenger responds to an invalid claim before game clocks expire
source_rules.evm_notes: 24,576-byte runtime and 49,152-byte initcode limits; Karst MODEXP/P256VERIFY/BN256-pairing behavior must be audited for the verifier

source_rules.security_assumption: Validity proof plus L1; Euclid enforced inclusion/emergency submission; upgrades controlled by 9-of-12 Security Council
source_rules.evm_notes: 24,576-byte runtime and 49,152-byte initcode limits; RIPEMD-160 and BLAKE2F disabled, MODEXP components limited to 32 bytes, no blob opcodes/EIP-4788
